# Standalone dock lacks heavy-content split-drag evidence

## Context

Parent #17844 AC-4 explicitly retains the `#17820` heavy-content journey evidence. Its current full headless census at `63bbeb6397` passes both Workstation Matrix geometry cases, but the inspected standalone dock journeys use plain component panes. `SplitterHeavyContent` lives in the component tier and is not selected by that E2E battery.

## The Problem

The standalone example has not supplied the real-pointer repeated split-drag receipt for representative Grid/TreeGrid panes. Plain panels cannot falsify buffered row/column geometry or final scrollability. Stored tree row count alone is also insufficient when every folder is collapsed.

Design authority: #17844 AC-4 and its explicit journey-authoring scope amendment; the landed main-thread conserved-pair preview from `#17820`. This ticket supplies evidence, not a new resize mechanism.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/dashboard/dock/MainContainer.mjs` is the actual standalone consumer and accepts construction-time pane/perspective declarations.
- `Workspace#onAfterConstructed` captures declarations once; runtime mutation of `panes` does not replace them.
- Existing RMA creation/destruction under the same Viewport permits a cold actual MainContainer with heavy declarations, without app changes or fixture subclasses.
- `Neo.grid.Container` consumes `data.Store`; its TreeStore mode supplies TreeGrid behavior.
- Existing BigData/TreeBigData models supply the numeric-column field shapes.
- `WorkstationSplitterGridGeometryNL` and `DockSplitterProxyPaintNL` establish geometry and Engine-floor E2E patterns.

## The Fix

Add one owning E2E sibling, `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/DockHeavyContentSplitNL.spec.mjs`, on `/examples/dashboard/dock/`. Cold-create the actual example MainContainer under its existing Viewport with ordinary heavy Grid/TreeGrid pane declarations, isolated existing storage key and one declared heavy perspective. Use deterministic Store/TreeStore records with an expanded root and sufficient visible rows/columns.

Exercise both split axes, repeated real-pointer movements in both directions and Escape. Observe conserved live pair geometry and unchanged committed document while held; then await the semantic commit/projection and verify keyed header/body/worker agreement and actual scrolling. Assert pane/store identities survive. Preserve unexpected-error failure.

No production source/config changes. If the journey exposes a product defect, preserve the failing witness and route a separate attributed repair under the parent.

Contract Ledger: N/A — test-only consumption of existing public primitives, no added surface.
Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 runtime preview/committed-document separation; no authority mutation.
Structure map: N/A — existing Body E2E directory and sibling pattern.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The actual standalone example route cold-mounts ordinary MainContainer declarations with live Grid and TreeGrid, representative visible data and observed readiness.
- [ ] Both axes execute repeated real-pointer drags in both directions; held frames show a conserved moving pair, no proxy in live mode, and byte-identical committed document.
- [ ] Release commits one semantic resize and coherent settled worker/header/body geometry without replacing pane/store identities.
- [ ] Escape restores captured geometry and leaves the document unchanged; final horizontal/vertical scrolling remains observable for both widgets.
- [ ] The complete new spec executes through the external-Brain E2E config, with unexpected errors retained; receipts name exact source/runtime and are linked to #17844.
- [ ] Existing Workstation geometry and standalone splitter witnesses remain green; no full-parent or native/headed acceptance is inferred from this focused leaf.

## Out of Scope

Generic resize/VDOM repair, new app features, custom fixture classes, fixture-only semantic commits, and closing parent acceptance.

## Avoided Traps

Do not replace the actual example with an empty-viewport-only host, mutate declarations after capture, treat collapsed stored rows as scroll evidence, or use direct semantic operations as the real-pointer witness.
